fieldNotes.truckGate: Dedicated controlled truck entrance off S Union Ridge Pkwy at the NE corner — a posted 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' sign at the parkway (confirmed in 2025-09 Street View), a structured entrance island and painted directional lane arrows where the drive meets the truck yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth could be visually confirmed. The truck entrance is heavily screened by a landscaped berm and conifer trees, and no Street View pano penetrates past the parkway frontage. A booth may exist but is not imaging-confirmed — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because a controlled truck gate exists but no booth is visually confirmed; check-in is likely kiosk/intercom. Verify in discovery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long entrance drive from the parkway gate into a very large open truck yard along the east face — comfortably holds a 3+ truck queue inside the property.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck yard inside the gate before the dock apron offers ample inside-the-gate holding room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and a very large internal truck yard; clear physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~800,000 sq ft DC (232,000 sq ft original + 541,000 sq ft 2019 expansion per UNFI Pacific Northwest optimization announcement). Long dock banks run BOTH the east and west faces of the building with trailers backed in; 50+ band, ~150 doors estimated.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters on different building faces (a west-face dock bank and an east-face dock bank), consistent with separate shipping vs. receiving operations. Medium confidence — flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large striped trailer drop yard on the east side holds many rows of parked trailers without tractors, plus a covered canopy structure among the rows; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage drop yard on the east side, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Ridgefield WA — edge-of-town location surrounded by farmland, woods and low-density rural residential; part of a small industrial park (Discovery Ridge area). Rural per the rubric (small-town/edge-of-town setting).
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.address: Confirmed 7909 S Union Ridge Pkwy, Ridgefield WA via Waze/TruckMap listings; given coordinates landed directly on the building. A separate large logistics facility (with a colorful orange/green trailer fleet) sits just NW and is a different operator — excluded.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Ridgefield, Washington" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "7909 S Union Ridge Pkwy, Ridgefield, WA 98642".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Ridgefield, Washington as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
